package.description: A utility for physical drive inspection and destructive whole-device media operations.

en-US.description: A utility for physical drive inspection and destructive whole-device media operations.
en-US.longDescription: HDD Low Level Format Tool is a utility for inspecting physical drives and performing destructive whole-device media operations. It supports NVMe, SATA, IDE, SCSI, SAS, USB, and FireWire devices. Features include full-device read verification, zero-write low-level formatting, whole-device TRIM or discard operations, device identity and health information, and exportable operation logs.
en-US.name: HDD Low Level Format Tool

zh-CN.longDescription: 免费的硬盘低级格式化工具，可以擦除、低级格式化并返修 SATA、IDE、SAS、SCSI、SSD 硬盘，任何 USB 和火线硬盘盒，以及 SD、MMC、记忆棒和 CompactFlash 介质。
zh-CN.name: Hard Disk Low Level Format Tool
